title: catalogue: pathways collection
description: catalogue/pathways.json holds the 13 pathways (CAT-1 AMENDMENT, Prompt 140 Unit 1). Each entry: id, number, name, book chapters, routes (which pathways it feeds and draws on), and the file holding its tiers.

id.description: Short id. Mechanically slugified from name where no source states a human-chosen short id (see report).

name.description: Full pathway name as given in the mapping doc.

chapters.description: Excelling at University chapter numbers this pathway draws on. null where the mapping doc states the book is silent (e.g. Track B authored pathways).

routes.description: Which pathways this one feeds and draws on. Not stated per-pathway by any source inspected for Prompt 140 Unit 1; recorded null throughout per the ruling against inferring routes from prose.

file.description: Repo-relative path to catalogue/pathways/<pathway>.json holding this pathway's tiers.
